name: Girl Doll Toy Gaiden Azami
original_name: Girl Doll Toy 外伝 AZAMI
source:
Protagonist is a Treasure Hunter who comes to a foreign land to get Miron 's treasure, but is reported and arrested by archaeologist Yuki. Hero agrees to cooperate and gets released. Together with Yuki they get on an adventure.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-may-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名宝藏猎人，为了取得米隆的宝藏而来到异国，却被考古学家雪举报并逮捕。主人公答应与她合作后获释，随后与雪一同踏上冒险之旅。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-may-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
